mutant.description: Every limb verdict in this act is an EQUALITY or an ABSENCE, and an extractor aimed at the wrong object reports IDENTICAL exactly as a genuinely unchanged function does. So each per-function identity verdict carries a planted mutation inside the function it certifies, each pinned read carries a negative control, and the pdf comparator carries both an instrument control and a planted corruption.

(3) planted inside _model_case_line -> FIRED. Each of (1)-(3) flagged only its own target.
